cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(stm32f407-clickerV2-soes LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)

# Preserve CPU flags supplied by an optional STM32 bundle toolchain.
set(cpu_PARAMS ${CPU_FLAGS})

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})
# Board sources, include paths, MCU definitions, and HAL drivers.
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)
# EtherCAT/application sources and generated build metadata.
include(cmake/soes.cmake)

target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${cpu_PARAMS}
    -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wno-unused-parameter
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>:-x assembler-with-cpp -MMD -MP>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-O0 -g3 -ggdb>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Os>
)

set(LINKER_SCRIPT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/STM32F407VGTX_FLASH.ld")
# CPU, nano.specs, section GC, map output, and memory reporting come from
# cmake/gcc-arm-none-eabi.cmake; retain the application-specific link settings.
target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    "-T${LINKER_SCRIPT}"
    ${cpu_PARAMS}
    -u _printf_float
    --specs=nosys.specs
    -Wl,--start-group -lc -lm -lstdc++ -lsupc++ -Wl,--end-group
    -Wl,-z,max-page-size=8
)
set_property(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS "${LINKER_SCRIPT}")

add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_SIZE} $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}>
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}> ${PROJECT_NAME}.hex
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}> ${PROJECT_NAME}.bin
    VERBATIM
)
